title: Lazar was only a radiation badge monitor for a logistics contractor and never went to Area 51
place_text: Las Vegas, near McCarran Airport; Area 51

tellings.quote: uh he doesn't know what he's talking about because he was a radiation health monitor for uh uh Kimber Meyer company and they were a logistics service uh company servicing Los Alamos National Lab in Area 51.

related.note: Both are about whether Lazar really worked at Los Alamos and S4. The story's teller says his work there was confirmed; Davis says he was only a radiation badge monitor for a logistics contractor and never went to Area 51.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site near Area 51, the closely guarded US Air Force test base in Nevada, was really just a radiation health monitor and never went to Area 51 at all. That is the claim of Eric W. Davis, a physicist who has worked on Pentagon-funded studies of these questions. Davis says Lazar "doesn't know what he's talking about" because he worked in the 1980s for a logistics company that serviced Los Alamos National Laboratory, a US nuclear weapons lab, and Area 51, which if true would undercut Lazar's whole story.
